besluite.fout: 'oorskryf' is ambiguous: besides 'copy out' it also reads as 'rewrite', which is close to the very thing the sentence tells the learner to do (write it in your own words).
besluite.rede: 'afskryf' is the plain school word for copying someone else's text, so it says exactly what was meant without moving the meaning, and it touches no protected wording.
